panels.title: Sources: requests and pages

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note) AS requests, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'ok') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note), 0) AS "ok %", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'throttled') AS throttled, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'refused') AS refused, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'gone') AS gone, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome IN ('server_error', 'client_error')) AS "http errors", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome IN ('timeout', 'network')) AS "timeouts, network", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'article_ok') AS "articles ok", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'article_failed') AS "articles failed", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome IN ('article_thin', 'article_empty', 'no_text')) AS "empty, thin", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'challenge') AS "bot check", 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'article_ok') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome LIKE 'article_%'), 0) AS "articles ok %", ROUND(AVG(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'ok')) AS "ms (ok)", MAX(at) AS "last request" FROM fetch_log WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY source ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.description: One row per source, over the time range. Requests: what the sites answered. Articles (news): the pages that gave an article, those that failed every extractor, those empty or too thin to extract. Twitter goes through its API: see the documents below.

panels.title: Documents and facts per source

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.source_type AS source, COUNT(*) AS documents, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.state = 'extracted') AS extracted, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.state = 'fetched') AS "to extract", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.state = 'failed') AS failed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sources s WHERE s.source_type = d.source_type AND $__timeFilter(s.scraped_at)) AS facts FROM source_documents d WHERE $__timeFilter(d.fetched_at) GROUP BY d.source_type ORDER BY documents DESC

panels.description: Documents fetched over the time range (articles, tweets, speeches, debate interventions), where they are in the extraction, and the facts stored.

panels.title: Failed requests per hour, per source

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', at) AS time, source || ' ' || outcome AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM fetch_log WHERE NOT note AND outcome <> 'ok' AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: News: every site

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT domain AS site, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note) AS requests, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'ok') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note), 0) AS "ok %", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'throttled') AS throttled, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'refused') AS refused, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'gone') AS gone, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome IN ('server_error', 'client_error')) AS "http errors", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome IN ('timeout', 'network')) AS "timeouts, network", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'article_ok') AS "articles ok", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'article_failed') AS "articles failed", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome IN ('article_thin', 'article_empty', 'no_text')) AS "empty, thin", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'challenge') AS "bot check", 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'article_ok') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome LIKE 'article_%'), 0) AS "articles ok %", ROUND(AVG(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'ok')) AS "ms (ok)", MAX(at) AS "last request" FROM fetch_log WHERE source = 'news' AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY domain) s ORDER BY "articles failed" + "empty, thin" DESC, requests DESC LIMIT 500

panels.description: Every site the news search led to, over the time range, the ones that fail most first. A site with a low 'articles ok %' gives us nothing: a paywall, an anti-bot, a page made of video.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', at) AS time, source AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM fetch_log WHERE NOT note AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Facts stored per hour, per source

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', scraped_at) AS time, source_type AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM fact_sources WHERE $__timeFilter(scraped_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sites of the other sources

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, domain AS site, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note) AS requests, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'ok') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note), 0) AS "ok %", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'throttled') AS throttled, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'refused') AS refused, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'gone') AS gone, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome IN ('server_error', 'client_error')) AS "http errors", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome IN ('timeout', 'network')) AS "timeouts, network", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'article_ok') AS "articles ok", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'article_failed') AS "articles failed", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome IN ('article_thin', 'article_empty', 'no_text')) AS "empty, thin", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'challenge') AS "bot check", 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome = 'article_ok') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE note AND outcome LIKE 'article_%'), 0) AS "articles ok %", ROUND(AVG(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE NOT note AND outcome = 'ok')) AS "ms (ok)", MAX(at) AS "last request" FROM fetch_log WHERE source <> 'news' AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY source, domain ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: vie-publique, the Assemblée nationale, the photos, the archive: per site.
